items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-07-31
items.q: When Barbara and I were in New Orleans on our honeymoon... Johnny was going to play... I talked to him for a while... mentioned my dad and he said oh yeah i remember old davis dino

ctx.x: Yeah. Except that I think that Johnny got especially mad for some of these. He had a lot of energy. Yeah, he did. And for somebody after working, teaching all day, teaching mechanical drawing at Warren Easton.

Well, you know, I remember, I remember, and I treasure the memory. Yeah. When Barbara and I were in New Orleans on our honeymoon in November of 73, and we happened by sheer good fortune to hit upon this, I think, Jazz Club 25th anniversary concert on the president, I guess it was, unless it was the Capitol. Which, I don't remember which was running at the time.
It even had been the president of the Admiral. It was the president then. Yeah.
